offer_title: Alfardan Automotive x First Finance Company permanent financing programme for BMW - 0% down Qataris / 10% expats, up to QAR 2M, up to 72 months, 3-month grace, no admin charges
validity_text: Permanent programme announced October 2025, 'now available across Alfardan Automotive showrooms'
status_reason: Described as a permanent programme (Oct 2025) available at all Alfardan Automotive showrooms; no end date; no 2026 re-confirmation found
evidence_quote: Alfardan Automotive ... announced a landmark collaboration with First Finance Company, a subsidiary of Dukhan Bank Group, introducing a permanent financing programme ... The programme, which is now available across Alfardan Automotive showrooms, offers customers a suite of benefits ... For Qataris, there's the added benefit of a 0% down payment, while expatriates can enjoy a 10% down payment. Installments are available for up to 72 months for Qataris and 48 months for expats, with a grace period of up to 3 months.
notes: Shari'ah-compliant; up to QAR 2M; no admin charges (per shard hint and ffcqatar.com). Expats max 48 months. Pre-approval via FFC Mobile App. Press: https://www.gulf-times.com/article/712065/business/alfardan-automotive-first-finance-company-launch-permanent-financing-programme-for-premium-vehicles-in-qatar . Note: QIB signed a separate Alfardan Automotive financing partnership in Feb 2026 (see bank-qib).
